description: Source code for an iOS Share Extension view controller that handles shared content, extracts data (text, URL, images), prepares a message draft, and sends it to an OpenClaw gateway with attachments.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: An iOS view controller managing sharing extension UI, content extraction, and communication with the OpenClaw gateway.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Sets up the view controller's UI and initial configurations.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Prepares the share draft when the view appears, avoiding repeated execution.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures the user interface elements including text view and buttons.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Extracts shared content, composes a draft message, and enables sending.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Initiates sending the current draft message.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Completes the extension without sending data.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Validates and transmits the draft message and attachments to the gateway.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Handles the network communication to send message and attachments to the OpenClaw gateway.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Determines if a connection retry with a legacy client ID is needed based on error.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status messages to the user overlay.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Creates a message string from shared content payload.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Cleans up text fragments by removing unwanted phrases and lines.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Parses extension context to extract shared items (title, URL, text, images).

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads and encodes an image attachment from provider data.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Determines preferred image type identifier from provider.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Compresses UIImage to JPEG ensuring size constraints.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Retrieves a URL from an item provider.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Retrieves text content from an item provider.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a URL value from a provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads text value from a provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Loads raw data from a provider for a specific type.
